body:
Real plain-call-shaped predicate function calls (e.g. is-zero, is-symbol?) as a cond test -- closes the second and last of the two real exclusions the same-day cond work explicitly named. Needed no new boxing/unboxing machinery: a Bool-returning function's own body already boxes 0/1 as a real NULL/non-NULL char* on the callee side (emit-i32-boxed via binary-op-call-shaped?), and a real C if(char_star_expr) already treats non-NULL as truthy -- zero extra casting needed at the call site. bool-expr-supported?/emit-bool-expr each gained one more clause; existing or/and/not recursion means a predicate call composes for free inside compound tests too. 2 new tests (27 total for domain 4) including a real compile+run+assert check against a genuine two-function program. Zero regressions: 336-test suite + all 6 selfhost test binaries + bazel build clean. Still open: match itself, cond as non-tail value, nested call arguments generally, defstruct not walked. PARENA commit 7d62cc4.

⚓ ☃
title: selfhost/emit.prn: plain-call predicate function calls as cond tests
